name: @freemodelfinder/repo
description: Development monorepo for the FreeModelFinder local LLM gateway, web UI and CLI.

scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md CHANGELOG.md SECURITY.md "docs/**/*.md" ".github/**/*.{json,md,yaml,yml}" "packages/**/*.{js,json,md,mjs,ts,tsx,yaml,yml}" "scripts/**/*.{js,mjs}" --ignore-path .gitignore --ignore-path .prettierignore
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @freemodelfinder/core test:coverage && pnpm --filter @freemodelfinder/server test:coverage && pnpm --filter freemodelfinder test:coverage && pnpm --filter @freemodelfinder/ui test:coverage
